verdict.rationale: Phaser's core engine is MIT-licensed (permanent, non-revocable once granted) per the runtime probe, and phaser.io/pricing explicitly states that games built continue to work even if a paid tool license lapses since 'they are not linked to the licence' (phaser-docs-41), directly addressing repricing/retroactive concerns for shipped games. However there's no explicit vendor statement or independent track record confirming pricing terms for the paid Editor/MCP tiers have never changed retroactively. Missing for 10: documented pricing-change history, explicit no-retroactive-repricing policy statement, independent confirmation from studios who shipped games under earlier pricing.
